name: Gen1 Upgrade Execution
description: Explicitly approved single-submission in-place upgrade, followed by exact-scope GET-only receipt observation. No refresh, grants, consumer changes or blind retry.

variables.GEN1_ID: One explicitly approved Gen1 UUID; repeat --id only within the reviewed scope.
variables.RECEIPT_ID: Local receipt UUID returned by the single submission, NOT a transport trace.

prerequisites: Complete backup/reload and consumer/storage/security review; explicit human approval of irreversible replacement.
Current owner or workspace Admin authorization; no automatic takeover or consent.
Do not use this workflow to retry already accepted/unknown work.

steps.description: Offline scoped preview with both guards. This is NOT approval.
ONLY after explicit approval: recheck complete all-ready assessment and submit EXACTLY ONCE. Retain the local receipt. Never repeat this step for accepted/unknown/partial work.
Observe only this same stored scope/operation with bounded GETs. Per-item failures/unknowns do not permit retry, and completion does not establish loaded/fresh Gen2 data.
Inspect the retained local receipt and sanitized result. Review separate approved refresh/consumer follow-up; never grant roles or switch modes automatically.
